blocks.text: Have you ever wondered what makes a product appealing to customers? Understanding product levels and types is crucial for any marketer.

blocks.markdown: In marketing, products are not just physical items; they encompass various levels that contribute to customer satisfaction. The three levels of a product are the **core product**, **actual product**, and **augmented product**. Each level serves a different purpose in meeting consumer needs.

blocks.title: Product Levels
blocks.text: 1. **Core Product**: The fundamental benefit or value that a customer gains from a product. 2. **Actual Product**: The tangible aspects of the product, including design, features, and packaging. 3. **Augmented Product**: Additional services or benefits that enhance the product's value, such as warranties or customer service.

blocks.markdown: Products can also be classified into three main types based on consumer buying behavior: **convenience goods**, **shopping goods**, and **speciality goods**. Understanding these classifications helps marketers tailor their strategies effectively.

items: 1. **Convenience Goods**: Items that are purchased frequently and with minimal effort, such as bread or soft drinks.
2. **Shopping Goods**: Products that consumers compare on attributes like quality and price, such as clothing or electronics.
3. **Speciality Goods**: Unique items that require special purchasing efforts, like luxury cars or designer handbags.

blocks.title: Identifying Product Levels
blocks.prompt: Consider a smartphone. Identify its core, actual, and augmented product levels.

steps.text: Core Product: The ability to communicate and access information.
Actual Product: The smartphone itself, including its brand, design, and features.
Augmented Product: Warranty, customer support, and software updates.

blocks.answer: Core Product: Communication; Actual Product: The smartphone; Augmented Product: Warranty and support.

blocks.markdown: Understanding the distinction between a product and a service is also vital. A product is a tangible item that can be sold, while a service is an intangible offering that provides value, such as haircuts or tutoring.

blocks.title: Exam Tip
blocks.text: When answering questions about product levels, always relate your answers to real-life examples to demonstrate your understanding.

points: Products consist of core, actual, and augmented levels that cater to different consumer needs.
Consumer goods are categorized into convenience, shopping, and speciality types based on purchasing behavior.
